data.name: Damodar
data.long_meaning: Damodar is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'one who holds the universe'. In Hindu mythology, Damodar refers to Lord Krishna, who holds the universe on his chest. This name is filled with spiritual significance and symbolizes love, compassion, and the power to hold and protect the universe.

historical_references.reference: Damodar River is named after Lord Krishna, who was once bound with ropes by his wife Satyabhama to prevent him from leaving her. The name Damodar means 'one who is bound with ropes'.

The name Damodar is also associated with the Damodar Valley Project, a hydroelectric power project in India, which was named after Lord Krishna in his avatar as Damodar. The project was completed in 1948.
